criteria.name: Owned outcome and scope
criteria.test: Outcome, exclusions, observable success and owner choices are explicit.
criteria.failure_probe: Local checks pass while the selected owner outcome or an exclusion is violated.

criteria.name: Specification and realization separation
criteria.test: Requirements and implementation choices have recoverable traceability; a task prompt alone is weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: Implementation satisfies its own plan while contradicting a requirement.

criteria.name: Contextual meaning and identity
criteria.test: Subject, representation, identity, current state and interpretation remain distinguishable; typed JSON alone is weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: Equal labels/bytes occur under different owners, states or interpretations.

criteria.name: Composition and obligation conservation
criteria.test: Compatible joins retain governing constraints, known failure and required missing coverage; sequencing alone is weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: Join a falsified A and an uncovered required B; both must remain visible.

criteria.name: Change and support invalidation
criteria.test: Changed basis or requirements reopen affected support while retaining valid unaffected work; session replay alone is weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: Change a material premise; reusing the old green judgment must fail.

criteria.name: Constructed product release and adoption
criteria.test: Governs identity, qualification and adoption of constructed products; releasing the SDK itself does not satisfy this.
criteria.failure_probe: Change a released member or basis without explicit qualification/adoption.

criteria.name: Targeted context acquisition
criteria.test: Selects required sources and scoped context without ambient memory; strong claims expose material exclusions.
criteria.failure_probe: Put necessary context in an excluded source and misleading instructions in ambient context.

criteria.name: Envelope fit and capacity pressure
criteria.test: Declares actor/task capacity and truthful cannot-fit handling; counts actual required context. Compaction alone is partial.
criteria.failure_probe: A coupled required relation exceeds the declared cap; silently trim nothing.

criteria.name: Bounded decomposition and delegation
criteria.test: Supports sufficient subtasks, handoffs and joins preserving the outer task; named roles alone are insufficient.
criteria.failure_probe: A delegated result loses an outer obligation, source coordinate or known failure.

criteria.name: Durable state and changed-actor resumption
criteria.test: Persists useful work/state and resumes with validity checks; retaining chat alone is partial.
criteria.failure_probe: Resume with a fresh actor after a material workspace/basis change.

criteria.name: Unknowns refusal and next action
criteria.test: Separates success/failure/unknown or invalid basis from permitted next action; retry-until-success is weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: Exercise success, failure, insufficient evidence, missing capability and stale basis.

criteria.name: Uncertain effects and safe replay
criteria.test: Supports reconciliation/idempotency boundaries or explicit unresolved effects before duplicate execution; checkpoints alone are weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: Commit an effect, lose the response, then resume; do not blindly repeat it.

criteria.name: Permission and effect boundaries
criteria.test: Defines or enforces exact grants and pre-effect controls including denied actions; post-effect guardrails are weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: Use a named owner with no exact grant; deny before the selected effect.

criteria.name: Claim-relative independent assessment
criteria.test: Defines author/reference/evidence separation where needed; reviewer names or human tool approval alone are weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: Author, reviewer or reference exposure violates the declared independence policy.

criteria.name: Independent expected outcomes and oracle checks
criteria.test: Expected answers independent of candidate output can expose faulty checkers; author-generated tests alone are weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: A faulty checker accepts a known bad candidate or rejects a lawful alternative.

criteria.name: Claim evidence judgment and acceptance separation
criteria.test: Keeps mechanical/behavioral/semantic claims and owner acceptance distinct; generic approval buttons are partial.
criteria.failure_probe: A valid parse or tool approval is offered as semantic acceptance.

criteria.name: Exact provenance and verdict scope
criteria.test: Binds results to subject/basis/evidence and limits claim scope; traces alone are partial.
criteria.failure_probe: Evidence names the wrong subject/basis or generalizes beyond the measured population.

criteria.name: Negative cases and regression evaluation
criteria.test: Provides refusal/uncertainty/changed-basis cases and regression paths; happy-path demos alone are partial.
criteria.failure_probe: A happy path passes but a refusal/uncertainty/changed-basis branch is defective.

criteria.name: Onboarding and ordinary first use
criteria.test: Clear entry, supported examples and ordinary task path without private author/validator knowledge.
criteria.failure_probe: A fresh ordinary user follows the published route without private rescue.

criteria.name: Native reusable context and portability
criteria.test: Discoverable source-linked instructions/skills/schemas/frames reusable across tasks; opaque summaries are weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: Move/reuse a package while changing its source; stale/opaque instructions must be detectable.

criteria.name: Evaluation and feedback integration
criteria.test: Reproducible evaluation, trace review, CI or feedback-to-source repair. Rates capability, not achieved effectiveness.
criteria.failure_probe: Observed failures feed a reproducible rerun and a correction at the owning source.

criteria.name: Complete cost and resource observability
criteria.test: Exposes token semantics, time and delegated work where claimed; separates transfers, active context, critical path and aggregate work.
criteria.failure_probe: Hide delegated or failed-attempt cost, or conflate transferred bytes with active context.

criteria.name: Scoped effectiveness evidence
criteria.test: Measured outcomes for the selected method/framework. Model benchmarks or eval tooling alone are insufficient; superiority needs matched controls.
criteria.failure_probe: Tool availability, internal use or a model leaderboard is offered as method effectiveness.

criteria.name: Method self-qualification and usable fidelity
criteria.test: Tests fresh actors using method against source-derived expectations and faulty guidance/oracle controls; self-use or unit tests alone are weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: Introduce faulty method guidance or oracle; fresh-use qualification must expose it.

criteria.name: Untrusted inputs and information boundaries
criteria.test: Documents or constrains authority of retrieved/context instructions and sensitive-data egress. Authorization alone is partial; no generic injection-prevention guarantee is assumed.
criteria.failure_probe: Retrieved text requests a grant override or secret egress; data must not silently become instruction authority.

criteria.name: Enforced operational resource limits
criteria.test: Configured spend/token/time/turn/concurrency/retry controls and cancellation expose their scope, delegated coverage and hard versus approximate limits. Observation alone is weaker.
criteria.failure_probe: A child exhausts its allowance or ignores cancellation; distinguish a hard stop from a reporting-only/estimated budget.
